about_the_game:
Welcome to Aquilon – a city where monster hunting intertwines with secrets, temptation, and thrilling adventures. This artbook unveils the world of Aquilon Sex Quest in all its depth and splendor.

Inside, you'll find:

  • Character Illustrations – from the fearless hunter to the captivating and dangerous women of Aquilon. Discover their personalities, desires, and hidden secrets.

  • Erotic Sketches – romantic moments and intimate scenes with heroines who have fallen for your charm.

  • Locations – key places where the saga unfolds, brought to life in stunning detail.

Turn the pages filled with seduction and danger, and immerse yourself in a world where every step is a challenge, and every night could be unforgettable. Are you ready to leave your mark on the history of Aquilon?

content_descriptors.notes: All characters depicted in this artbook are over the age of 21. The artbook contains a large amount of sexual content
